title: 第3章 灵魂碎片第4章 变异装备
content_zh:
【0阶灵魂碎片：8】
随着所有提示信息变淡消失，他眼角还能看到最后残留不变的一行文字。
“这是我的天赋神魂异化所捡的灵魂碎片？”
方南山以为是要自己拾取的，没想到是直接吸收过来，非常的人性化。
没想到这些异界降临的“玩家”们死亡，也会掉落灵魂碎片，他还以为要怪物这些敌对的目标才会掉落。
但要怎么使用这些碎片呢？
他又打开面板再认真仔细的研究一下天赋的解释说明。
“消耗碎片使我正在操作的目标产生不可预测的变化？是不是攻击的时候，消耗碎片会打出暴击或者其他异常伤害？也有可能会给对手加血加状态？这不可预测的变化，那就是所产生的效果是随机的，可能是好的，也可能是坏的。”
“这样的话，用在攻击上好像也未必讨好，用在自己身上呢？如果在锻炼的时候给自己来一发，运气不好的话减属性就糟糕了。”
“不行，不能用在自己身上，只能用在生产制造过程中，运气好可以得到极品的优质产品，就算运气不好，得到奇葩又糟糕的产品，损失也可以接受。”
方南山迅速分析着这个天赋的作用，灵魂碎片的用途，好像也没有想象中那么大。
在战斗中和修炼中是不能轻易使用的。
那只能用在生活技能中，修仙百艺将会成为他的主修课程吧。
只是现在好像对解决他面临的困境，没什么帮助啊。
再怎么变异，也不能让他一击秒杀骷髅吧，也许八个碎片能出一次致命一击的效果，但杀一个骷髅怪也解决不了现在的问题。
此时护罩外面两侧都有几只骷髅怪，前后方位虽然没有，但都处于怪物的感应范围内，一出去肯定会被追杀，走不出三五十米，就要被追上秒杀了。
“真糟糕！没想到事情会变成这样，羊先生，现在只剩下我们两个了，如果要存活下去，我们可能要好好合作才行。”
方南山把目光投向那羊蹄异人，现在整个据点只剩下两人，他不用担心受到小团伙的威胁，说话底气也足了很多。
异星羊人此时才如梦初醒，从极度震惊中回过神来，侧身看向方南山，“你，你们蓝星人，果然是恶魔般的存在！太可怕了！你们怎么可以做出这种邪恶的事情来？！”
“羊先生，你要看清楚，本人也是受害者。在蓝星，那些邪恶的民族也同样伤害过我们华族，我对你们的遭遇感同身受，来吧，让我们诚挚合作，共同变强，再找他们算帐！”

“我不会再相信你们蓝星人族，只剩下两人根本不可能生存下来，我不想浪费时间，半年后再见！”小羊人脸色变幻不定，最后还是一咬牙，做出了艰难的选择，冲出了保护罩。
方南山轻叹一声，伸手扶额，这下好了，才不到一个小时，整个新人据点，就只剩下他孤单一人，真正是一匹独狼了。
“0阶灵魂碎片+1。”
这个羊人也是刚烈啊，但心理承受能力真的差，完全打不了逆风局，小劣就送人头，实在不可取。
“现在要怎么办？”
方南山要独自面对这个令人绝望的局面。
“先看看这几件东西值几个钱吧。”
content_en:
[Level 0 soul fragment: 8]
As all the prompts faded and disappeared, he could still see the last remaining unchanged line of text in the corner of his eye.
"Are these the soul fragments picked up by my talent of divine soul alienation?"
Fang Nanshan thought he was picking it up by himself, but he didn't expect it to be absorbed directly. It was very humane.
Unexpectedly, when these "players" from another world died, they would also drop soul fragments. He thought they would only be dropped by hostile targets such as monsters.
But how to use these fragments?
He opened the panel again and studied the explanation of talent carefully.
"Consuming the fragments will cause unpredictable changes to the target I am operating? Will consuming the fragments cause a critical hit or other abnormal damage when attacking? Or may it increase the opponent's health and status? This unpredictable change means that the effect is random and may be good or bad."
"In this case, it seems that it may not be flattering when used in attacks, but what if it is used on yourself? If you use it on yourself during training, it will be bad if you are unlucky and your attributes will be reduced."
"No, you can't use it on yourself, you can only use it in the manufacturing process. If you are lucky, you can get the best high-quality products. Even if you are unlucky and get weird and terrible products, the loss is acceptable."
Fang Nanshan quickly analyzed the function of this talent. It seems that the use of soul fragments is not as great as imagined.
It cannot be used easily during combat or training.
That can only be used in life skills. Cultivation of immortality and hundreds of arts will become his major course.
But now it doesn't seem to be of much help in solving the dilemma he faces.
No matter how much he mutates, he can't kill a skeleton in one blow. Maybe eight fragments can deliver a fatal blow, but killing a skeleton monster won't solve the current problem.
At this time, there are several skeleton monsters on both sides of the outside of the shield. Although there are no front and rear positions, they are all within the monster's sensing range. They will definitely be chased and killed as soon as they go out. If they can't go more than thirty or fifty meters, they will be caught up and killed instantly.
"It's so bad! I didn't expect things to turn out like this, Mr. Sheep, there are only two of us left now. If we want to survive, we may have to work together."
Fang Nanshan turned his attention to the strange man with sheep's hoof. Now there were only two people left in the entire stronghold. He didn't have to worry about being threatened by the small gang, and he had a lot more confidence in speaking.
At this moment, the alien goatman seemed to be waking up from a dream. He recovered from the extreme shock and looked sideways at Fang Nanshan, "You, you Blue Star people, are indeed demonic existences! It's terrible! How can you do such evil things?!"
"Mr. Sheep, you have to see clearly that I am also a victim. In Blue Star, those evil ethnic groups have also harmed us Chinese people. I feel for your experiences. Come on, let us cooperate sincerely and become stronger together, and then we will settle accounts with them!"
"I will never trust you Blue Star human race again. It's impossible for the two of you to survive. I don't want to waste time. See you again in half a year!" The little goat man's expression changed, but he finally gritted his teeth, made a difficult choice, and rushed out of the protective shield.
Fang Nanshan sighed softly and put his hand on his forehead. It was better now. In less than an hour, he was the only one left in the entire newcomer base. He was truly a lone wolf.
"Level 0 soul fragment +1."
This goat man is also strong-willed, but his mental endurance is really poor. He can't fight against the headwind situation at all. He will be killed for a small mistake, which is really not advisable.
"What to do now?"
Fang Nanshan has to face this desperate situation alone.
"Let's first see how much these things are worth."
